title: tecoma meonantha
intro: Tecoma meonantha, commonly known as Yellow Bells or Esperanza, is a flowering plant species native to Mexico and Central America. This plant is known for its bright yellow, bell-shaped flowers that bloom throughout the year, providing a vibrant display of color. The health benefits of Tecoma meonantha include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor activities.
